689ef884022176ff427a54fd0fa8de2ec4e49c44: Aeschiried is a small, modestly sized resort – 10 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where you come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Aeschiried's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It's one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Aeschiried's moderate altitude – starting at 927 m, topping out at 1389 m – makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before you set off is strongly recommended. At €37, the day lift pass places Aeschiried among the mid-range resorts on price – neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short: Aeschiried doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
